levels.full:
# Future with will

## Core concept
Use will + base verb for spontaneous decisions, promises, and predictions: I will call you.

## How it works
In negatives use will not or won’t; in questions place will before the subject.

## What to watch out for
Do not add -s or to after will: She will arrive, not She will arrives.

## Worked example
It is cloudy. I think it will rain. I will take an umbrella.

## Try it yourself
Write a new example using the rule and explain why it works.
